anya_ops: FYI we got 4 customers double-nudged by the onboarding playbook around 07:12 UTC. quick heads-up.
liam_playbooks: thanks. got run_id? rule name?
anya_ops: run=run_20260412_0712, rule=onboard_engage_v2, healthscore change 0.7->0.45, two sends within ~5m.
liam_playbooks: suspect dedupe key again. can you paste the event?
anya_ops: snippet: {"acct":"acct_903", "last_touch": null, "txn_id": "tx_882", "score":0.45}
raj_data: we recently rolled recency fix that can zero out legacy `last_touch`. that would make dedupe collapse if code expects it non-null.
liam_playbooks: our logic sets dedupe = last_touch when present else acct. but if last_touch exists but is null we treat it as present and use null. will harden to concat acct+txn.
liam_playbooks: quick patch: `dedupe_key = acct + ':' + (last_touch || txn_id)` and push to staging.
zoe_enablement: paused onboard_engage_v2 in UI, adding note to the release checklist to revert recency flag if this recurs.
ops-bot: playbook paused onboard_engage_v2 by zoe_enablement at 4979990100
raj_data: I'll run a small backfill to populate last_touch for recent touches: `./scripts/backfill_last_touch --since 2026-04-12T06:00Z` ETA ~6m.
liam_playbooks: after backfill + patch we run dry-run for 20m then enable. thanks all. :thumbsup:
